workflow.critical: All generated test case content must be in {reporting_language}
Execute ALL steps in exact order — do NOT skip steps

MANDATORY FINAL STEP: The workflow is NOT complete until Step 5 has written the updated status to TestResult/test-suites.yml. The completion summary and "Next step" prompt are displayed ONLY inside Step 5, after the file is saved. Do NOT output "Phase 2 Complete" or any "Next step" before Step 5 finishes.
Output base path for all artifacts: {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/
SELF-REVIEW RULE: After generating files, execute the quality checklist before reporting complete. Fix all failures before finishing.

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first, then retry.

step.action: Read TestResult/test-suites.yml and find the suite entry where name = {suite_name}

check.output: ❌ Suite "{suite_name}" not found in TestResult/test-suites.yml. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} first to register it.

step.action: Load from suite entry: - {story_files} = list of story file paths from the suite's stories field - {story_id} = {suite_name} - {current_status} = suite status field
Read ALL story files in {story_files}; merge acceptance criteria into one unified set; de-duplicate identical ACs
Store {ac_count} = total number of unique acceptance criteria across all stories
Store {story_count} = number of story files in the suite

step.goal: Verify suite has reached the minimum required status

check.if: {current_status} rank is 0 (not yet story-analyzed — suite exists but has no valid status)
check.output: ❌ Suite "{suite_name}" has not been analyzed yet. Current status : {current_status} Required status : story-analyzed (minimum) Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} first.

step.action: Skill generates output files at {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/ - If total test cases ≤ 50: single file set → {story_id}-test-cases.xlsx / .md / .csv - If total test cases > 50: split into parts → {story_id}-test-cases-part1.xlsx, -part2.xlsx, … (same for .md and .csv)
Store {part_count} = number of generated file parts (1 if not split, N otherwise)

step.goal: Self-review — verify artifacts and test case quality

check.file: XLSX test cases — RTL Arabic workbook with 17 columns
Markdown test cases — grouped by test type

artifact-checklist.check: For each part N from 1 to {part_count}: XLSX part N — RTL Arabic workbook with 17 columns Markdown part N — grouped by test type

quality-checklist.check: Both XLSX and MD files exist at the correct paths inside {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/
Every AC from ALL provided stories has at least one positive test case — total positive tests ≥ {ac_count}
Every AC has at least one negative test case covering invalid/rejected input
Edge case test cases are present (boundary values, empty inputs, max-length, special characters)
Security and permission test cases are present when the story involves authentication or roles (SQL injection, XSS, unauthenticated access, RBAC)
Each test case has all required fields populated — ID, title, description, preconditions, numbered steps, test data, expected result — no field is blank
Steps use actual field names, URLs, and values from the story — no placeholders like "[field]" or "[value]"
Expected results are specific and measurable — NOT vague ("يعمل بشكل صحيح" or "system works correctly")
Test types span the required categories: وظيفي، تحقق، حد، أمان، صلاحيات (where applicable to the story)

review.fix-if-needed: TC-2/TC-3 → add missing test cases for uncovered ACs and negative scenarios TC-4 → add at least 3 edge case tests: empty input, boundary value, special characters TC-5 → add security (SQL injection, XSS payloads) and permission (unauthenticated redirect, RBAC denial) cases TC-6/TC-7 → fill any blank fields with accurate, story-specific content; replace all placeholders with real values TC-8 → rewrite vague expected results to be specific and measurable outcomes TC-9 → renumber any duplicate IDs sequentially (TC-0001, TC-0002, …) TC-10 → translate all content to {reporting_language} TC-11 → add missing test type categories if story warrants them Save corrected files before marking complete.

step.critical: This step MUST execute. Do not skip it. The workflow is not complete until test-suites.yml is written.
step.action: Update the entry: - phases.generate-test-cases: done - status: if current rank < rank("test-cases-generated") → set to "test-cases-generated"; otherwise keep existing (never downgrade) - test-cases-parts: {part_count} ← record number of split files so downstream phases can discover all parts - updated: {current_date}
Write the updated content back to TestResult/test-suites.yml
step.output:
📋 test-suites.yml updated — suite "{suite_name}" → test-cases-generated
✅ Phase 2 Complete — Test Cases Generated and Verified
Generated files ({part_count} part(s)): [IF {part_count} == 1] 📊 {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/{story_id}-test-cases.xlsx 📄 {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/{story_id}-test-cases.md [ELSE for each part N from 1 to {part_count}] 📊 {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/{story_id}-test-cases-partN.xlsx 📄 {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/{story_id}-test-cases-partN.md [END]
Summary: - Stories processed : {story_count} - ACs covered : {ac_count} - Total test cases : (count from generated MD file(s)) - File parts : {part_count} - Language : {reporting_language}
⚠️ ACs with only 1 test scenario (coverage risk): (list any, or "none")
